_about: The well room (the drowned body in the well; the mine's way down). Room Review round 23 (2026-10-10, Josh): WELLROOM/1 the well's water as the spa's, scaled to the small pool -- the surface is the part 'death' (NIBODYBASE, y -35, a hexagon x 7..78, z -100..-39), which is not named for water, so 'water.parts' marks it; WELLROOM/2 its light rippling on the ceiling (85.5, 120 above it) and the pipes; WELLROOM/3 the painted darkness made real in a black volumetric fog (as CORICORI); WELLROOM/4 a torch; WELLROOM/5-6 two faint hazy teal lights for the well's glow.

volume._about: As CORICORI (WELLROOM/3): black air that absorbs with distance, lit by the lights as they pass; paint = thicker black where the ORIGINAL art is painted dark.

artLight._about: WELLROOM/3 (Josh: dark mist like the black areas drawn on the textures): as MINEHEAD -- the ORIGINAL art's painted light and shade, per texel, shades the room level and the bounce (the placed lights untouched), so the painted black reads as real darkness; on top of the black painted-darkness fog, which here lies mostly along the walls.

water._about: WELLROOM/1-2: SPAROOM's water (same glow colour, glow, shine, glints) scaled to a pool about 70 units across instead of 600: one lamp under the middle, finer ripples and caustic web; the caustics' height 200 puts the ceiling 120 up at 55% (the light also spreads height/2 = 100 units past the pool's edge, so the three walls round the well and its pipes take it). parts = which part IS the water (its material is not named for it).
